author: Serialchiller_13
title: Frustrating and Inconsistent Service
review_text: I’ve had a very frustrating experience with eSewa lately. The app is highly unreliable, especially when you need it the most. There have been multiple instances where payments failed to go through while I was trying to pay in public, which can be quite embarrassing.What’s worse is that these issues seem to occur more often when you’re in a rush or under pressure, making the situation even more stressful. Unfortunately, this isn’t a one-time problem—I’ve been facing it repeatedly in recent days.I really hope eSewa improves its reliability and performance, as consistent failures like this make it difficult to trust the platform for everyday transactions.

author: smbdytyutk
title: i genuinely hate esewa. why develop an app that just doesn’t work.
review_text: I’m on my period and just wanted a few bars of chocolate, so I went out to buy some. I had more than enough money on the app, but when the cashier pulled out the scanner, it wouldn’t work. It didn’t scan the first time, or the second or even the fifth. I even tried taking a picture of the code and uploading it, thinking that might help but it kept saying “service not available.” In the end, I had to go home empty-handed. And the worst part is, this isn’t a one-time issue. It happens every time I’m in a situation where I really need the app to work. I’m genuinely tired of dealing with this every single time I have to pay.
